01. About
The person behind the captions
Based in Geelong. Studying business by day, running them the rest of the time.

I'm completing a Bachelor of Business (Marketing) in Melbourne, graduating in 2026, though most of what I know, I learned in real time building my own brand.

That brand is Duco Beauty, a home-based lash studio built from a single kit and an Instagram page into a fully booked, brand-led business, sustained entirely by word of mouth and Instagram Stories, without a single dollar of paid marketing. Alongside it, I create content and marketing for hospitality and lifestyle clients who need someone who can write the caption, shoot the reel, and explain exactly why it works.

I care less about looking polished than about being right: about the hook, the audience, the detail that actually stops someone mid-scroll.
